onboarding.title:
Get alerted when your blood
type is needed
onboarding.subtitle: VitalPulse matches urgent hospital requests to your blood type and location, so you only hear about the moments where you can truly help.

phoneEntry.errorTooLong: That's too many digits for this country.

phoneEntry.hospitalStaffCta: Sign in with your facility ID

otpVerify.title: Verify your number
otpVerify.helperText: Didn't receive a code? Check your SMS inbox or try again shortly.
otpVerify.errorInvalid: That code didn't work. Try again.

notificationPrimer.title: Seconds matter
notificationPrimer.subtitle: Enable notifications so we can reach you the moment a patient near you needs your exact blood type.
notificationPrimer.benefit1: Alerts only for your blood type and nearby city
notificationPrimer.benefit2: Every request is reviewed by a coordinator first
notificationPrimer.benefit3: Your contact details stay private until you accept

biometricSetup.title: Lock VitalPulse with Face ID
biometricSetup.subtitle: Your donation history and health details are sensitive. Face ID adds an extra layer of protection every time you open the app.
biometricSetup.faceIdHint: Use Face ID to unlock the app

profileSetup.title: Tell us about yourself
profileSetup.bloodTypeSourceHint: Self-reported blood type is used for general matching only — bring lab results to a donation to get it verified.
